API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPolicy ManagementAdd a new policy rule for a given policy.
Add a new policy rule for a given policy.
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/:customerId/policySet/:policySetId/rule

Add a new policy rule for a given policy.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

policySetId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the policy.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED

string
REQUIRED
